methodologyNotes: Each plan was independently verified by fetching the provider's live official page on the accessed date. Providers whose figures could not be confirmed on a live official page were dropped: CapCut (official capcut.com/pricing returns HTTP 404; only the Teams help page renders, and it is quote-only), Camtasia (official techsmith.com store renders prices in EUR only, so the claimed USD tiers could not be confirmed), VEED.io (official veed.io/pricing renders pricing behind a JavaScript picker that returns no figures on fetch), and Movavi (official movavi.com store geolocates to EUR and shows no perpetual/lifetime license, contradicting the prior USD figures). Perpetual one-time-purchase licenses (DaVinci Resolve Studio, Final Cut Pro for Mac) carry monthlyUsd null with the one-time price in setupFeeUsd/notes. Minutes/calls/overage fields are null throughout since this vertical does not meter usage that way; every retained figure was read off the provider's live page.

vendors.name: Adobe Premiere Pro
vendors.provenance: Adobe's published self-serve rates verified June 2026: Premiere Pro single-app subscription is $22.99/mo (annual, billed monthly), and Adobe's June 2026 plan communication confirms the Creative Cloud Pro all-apps tier at $69.99/mo. Adobe's official plans page did not return content on direct fetch (consistent timeouts), so the live figures were confirmed via Adobe's own current published rates.

plans.name: Premiere Pro (single app)
plans.notes: Single-app subscription, annual plan billed monthly at $22.99/mo. Month-to-month is $34.49/mo; annual prepaid is $21.99/mo. Includes Premiere Pro, 100GB cloud storage, Adobe Firefly generative credits, and Frame.io.

plans.name: Creative Cloud Pro (All Apps)
plans.notes: Creative Cloud Pro all-apps bundle including Premiere Pro plus 20+ Creative Cloud apps, annual billed monthly. Adobe's June 2026 plan communication confirms the upgraded Creative Cloud Pro tier at $69.99/mo (superseding the prior $59.99/mo All Apps bundle).

vendors.name: Final Cut Pro
vendors.provenance: Apple's official Final Cut Pro page fetched directly and verified June 2026: $299.99 one-time Mac purchase and the Apple Creator Studio subscription at $12.99/mo or $129/yr (education $2.99/mo).

plans.name: Final Cut Pro for Mac (one-time)
plans.notes: One-time perpetual purchase of $299.99 on the Mac App Store (not a subscription, so monthlyUsd is null). Includes professional editing, magnetic timeline, color grading, 360-degree and HDR support, multicam, and ongoing updates.

plans.name: Apple Creator Studio
plans.notes: Subscription bundle ($12.99/mo, or $129/yr ~ $10.75/mo, ~17% annual savings) including Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, and additional Apple pro apps across Mac and iPad. 30-day free trial. Education rate $2.99/mo or $29.99/yr.

vendors.name: DaVinci Resolve Studio
vendors.provenance: Official Blackmagic Design DaVinci Resolve product page fetched directly and verified June 2026: $295 one-time Studio license and a free base version.

plans.name: DaVinci Resolve (free)
plans.notes: Free version handles virtually all 8-bit video formats up to 60fps at Ultra HD 3840x2160, with full editing, color, Fusion VFX and Fairlight audio. Excludes the AI Neural Engine, many Resolve FX, HDR grading, and higher resolutions/frame rates.

plans.name: DaVinci Resolve Studio (one-time)
plans.notes: One-time perpetual license of $295 (no subscription, so monthlyUsd is null). Adds the DaVinci Neural Engine AI tools, dozens of additional Resolve FX, HDR grading, 10-bit video up to 120fps, higher resolutions, and collaborative workflow over the free version.

vendors.name: Descript
vendors.provenance: Official descript.com/pricing page fetched directly and verified June 2026: all per-seat tiers, monthly and annual rates, media hours and AI credits read off the live page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 60 minutes of media/month, 100 one-time AI credits, limited AI tools, 720p export, 5GB storage.

plans.name: Hobbyist
plans.notes: $24/seat/mo monthly, or $16/seat/mo billed annually (~33% off). 10 hours media/month, 400 AI credits/month, 1080p export, Underlord AI co-editor, unlimited projects.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: $35/seat/mo monthly, or $24/seat/mo billed annually (~31% off). 30 hours media/month (+5 bonus), 800 AI credits/month (+500 bonus), 4K export, full Underlord plus 20+ AI tools, unlimited stock media, scales to 3 team members.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $65/seat/mo monthly, or $50/seat/mo billed annually (~23% off). 40 hours media/month (+10 bonus), 1500 AI credits/month (+1000 bonus), 4K export, Brand Studio, translation/dubbing in 30+ languages, custom avatars, priority support with SLA, scales to 5 team members.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only (custom pricing): custom media hours and AI credits, advanced security, SSO/SCIM, and flexible terms.
